description:
About The Role… 

 The Logistics Engineering teams design, build and operate the applications and services that serve the evolving needs of caregivers. As we expand our capabilities to effectively manage patient flows across and within hospital systems, we seek the best and brightest engineering talent to be part of our growth.

 Our team is looking for a Software Engineer to drive the expansion of features to our customers through services that the team owns and operates on our event based microservice platform.

 What You’ll Do… 

 
 Understanding and solving business needs at scale with high-quality solutions

 Building and operating resilient services and infrastructure

 Creating metrics, dashboards and alerts to measure and meet SLOs for service performance, errors and availability and reacting to resolve issues in an on-call rotation

 Build on AWS services such as Lambda, EKS, S3, EC2, RDS, Document DB

 
 What We Look For… 

 
 0-2 years of expertise in Java, Go, or similar object-oriented languages

 Experience debugging in Production

 Ability to design, build and operate highly scalable, secure, and fault-tolerant services

 Experience in contributing to architectural decisions

 Motivated to dive deep to understand problems and customer pain points, and solve them using appropriate engineering principles

 Working understanding of event driven architecture and microservices

 
 Nice to haves... 

 
 Interest in underlying cloud infrastructure

 General understanding of hospital operations

 Development experience with Spring

 
 Success Criteria 

 
 Own Getting Things Done: Given an objective, you plan out how to get there and see it through

 Grow in Knowledge and Skill: There are things you need to learn to tackle tasks at hand, but expanding your learning beyond that is something you do habitually

 Communicate Clearly, Concisely and Effectively: Connecting with people is important to you and you work to become successful

 Deliver Frequently and Incrementally: Breaking down problems into smaller chunks, testing them and getting feedback is a discipline you hold yourself to

 Solve Problems Effectively and Efficiently: Weighing the options and picking the one most likely to fit best, is a strength that you build on

 Share Knowledge and Ideas: You jump in to contribute to the pool of ideas and provide guidance

 
 Education 

 Bachelor's degree in computer science (required)
Master's degree in computer science (preferred)

 Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. 
 Benefits 

 
 Employee Medical/dental/vision premiums paid 100% - family members without coverage Medical 100% - small cost for dependents on dental and vision, which start from day one!

 Life and AD&D

 Flexible Spending Accounts: Medical, Dependent Care, and Transportation

 401 (k) Retirement Savings

 Tuition Reimbursement

 Military Paid Leave (up to 6 months of base salary while on military leave)

 Paid Time Off

 Paid parental leave

 
 Disclaimer: 

 The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The term "qualified individual with a disability" means an individual with a disability who, with or without reasonable accommodation, can perform the essential functions of the position. 

 TeleTracking is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. TeleTracking recruits qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, age, ethnic or national origin, veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, marital status, or citizenship status. 

 Recruiting agencies, please do not submit unsolicited referrals for this or any open role. We have a roster of agencies with whom we partner, and we will not pay any fee associated with unsolicited referrals.
